facts.business: Valor Estate Ltd. is a full-service development company specializing in large scale urban regeneration projects across the Mumbai Metro Region.

auditor.name: N. A. Shah Associates LLP
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: 1. Uncertainty relating to future outcome of pending litigations or regulatory actions (Note 49). 2. Reliance on valuer reports and internal assessment for fair valuation of investments, loans, inventories, security deposits and project advances (Note 48).

key_risks: Uncertainty relating to pending litigations or regulatory actions
Valuation of inventory and investments dependent on management estimates and valuer reports
Liquidity risk and dependence on raising fresh debt and recovery from financial assets
Legal matters involving cases filed by Investigating Authorities with pending appeals
Project execution risks including approval delays and disputes (e.g., Orchid Ozone, OM Metals)
Capital commitment obligations and license fee obligations
facts.related_party_note: Corporate guarantees and pledges given on behalf of related entities including Majestic Infracon Private Limited, Adani Goodhomes Private Limited, MIG (Bandra) Realtors & Builders Private Limited, Radius Estates & Developers Private Limited, and Bamboo Hotels and Global Centre (Delhi) Private Limited. Managerial remuneration paid to managing directors, executive directors and their relatives. Sitting fees paid to independent and non-executive directors. Inter-corporate deposits from related parties.
